results.title: Flux is rated "Poor" with 1.8 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Evaluating 124 reviews, most reviewers were unhappy with their experience overall. Consumers expressed deep frustration regarding unexpected subscription charges and confusing billing practices experienced during the active free trial periods. People noted that the platform rapidly consumes usage credits, resulting in unexpected extra payments without prior warning. Reviewers also mentioned extrem e difficulties when trying to cancel active subscriptions directly through the user interface. Some reviewers were happy with the platform's modern PCB design features, despite the widespread financial setbacks. These customers found the cloud-based environment very practical, easy to use, and exceptionally helpful for managing their actual projects.See more
